LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOverflowTooltip: The network is over capacity. Stored hemogel is preserved, but new production is blocked until the reserve falls below capacity.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFoundingDescription: Place the stationary flesh moon over an empty surface tile or one of your loaded maps and found the first abstract outpost. Over an empty tile the Moon lowers its own mapless feeding link as part of the operation; over a loaded map an open physical umbilicus channel is required and that map is consumed. The operation is irreversible and costs {0} hemogel from the Moon.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCaptureConfirm: Spend {0} hemogel to order the capture of world tile {1}? Estimated time: {2}. Manually canceling the order will not refund the payment.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCancelOrderWarning: Cancel this capture order? The paid {0} hemogel will not be refunded.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCreateOutpostWarning: Grow a permanent abstract outpost here for {0} hemogel? It cannot be removed or visited, and only {1}% of its host tile output will reach the network.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTerritoryEnterDesc: Materialize this covered tile as a temporary map and enter it. The map cannot become a permanent settlement.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertPlayerMapWarning: Consume this loaded map and found the first flesh outpost for {0} Moon hemogel? All {1} eligible colonists, prisoners, animals, and controlled fleshbeasts will be evacuated to the Moon. Local hemogel will be transferred in full and existing flesh structures and terrain will return {2} hemogel. All other buildings, items, and map contents will be destroyed without payment. The map and its world object will be deleted permanently and you will not be able to return to this tile.
LanguageData.FB_MoonOutpostConsumeMapWarning: Consume this loaded map and grow a flesh outpost here for {0} Moon hemogel? All {1} eligible colonists, prisoners, animals, and controlled fleshbeasts will be evacuated to the Moon. Local hemogel will be transferred in full and existing flesh structures and terrain will return {2} hemogel. All other buildings, items, and map contents will be destroyed without payment. The map and its world object will be deleted permanently, and the tile becomes an abstract hive that leaves only {3}% of its output for the network.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertMoonMapUnavailable: The Moon map must be loaded and able to receive the evacuation.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertPhysicalChannelReq: Open a physical umbilicus channel to the loaded map on this tile before consuming it into a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_MoonOutpostConsumeMapNotConsumable: The Moon can only consume its own anchor map, a flesh territory map, or one of your own settlements. This map belongs to someone else - break it with an assault or the standard umbilicus absorption instead.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertContainedPawns: {0} controlled living pawn(s) are inside containers or otherwise unspawned. Release them onto the map before consuming it.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertQuestBlocked: This map, tile, or one of its evacuees is involved in an active quest.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertArrivalSpaceUnavai: There is not enough safe free space on the Moon to evacuate every eligible pawn.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertFailed: The map could not be consumed into a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertCompleted: Map consumed. Evacuated pawns: {0}. Flesh refund: {1} hemogel.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkExpansionDesc: Choose the active Moon or flesh outpost with the reserve bar, then spread flesh or grow another command center.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkNodeReserveTooltip: Hemogel available to the connected flesh component controlled from the outpost on tile {0}. Click to choose another node.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonReserveTooltip: The Moon strategic commands spend only its own internal reserve. Click to choose another node.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkSelectNodeTooltip: Click to select the Moon or a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCaptureDesc: Left-click to choose an empty world tile adjacent to covered territory and issue one paid capture order. Distance from the outpost does not matter. Live hostile settlements cannot be consumed by this command; use Attack settlement instead. Right-click toggles automatic expansion; the outpost then chooses the cheapest valid empty frontier tile of its own connected network whenever it is idle and that network can pay. If hemogel is insufficient, automatic expansion stays enabled and waits for the network reserve to refill.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCreateOutpostDesc: Grow an abstract outpost on an unloaded covered tile in this connected network for {0} hemogel. The hive keeps part of its own tile output, so only {1}% reaches the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFirstOutpostRequired: Found the first flesh outpost before creating a separate infection focus.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonSeedDesc: Instantly consume the empty surface tile directly beneath the stationary Moon. If no umbilicus is attached here yet, the Moon lowers its mapless feeding link as part of the operation. The terrain-based price is paid strictly from the Moon internal reserve, creating a new flesh focus.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonSeedConfirm: Spend {0} hemogel from the Moon internal reserve and irreversibly cover world tile {1} with flesh?
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonSeeded: The Moon has established a new flesh focus on world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostDesc: Instantly grow an outpost beneath the stationary Moon for {0} hemogel from its internal reserve. With no umbilicus here the Moon lowers its mapless feeding link first; with an open physical channel the loaded map on this tile is consumed instead. If the tile is not covered yet, its terrain-based flesh seeding cost is added and both operations are confirmed together. Only {1}% of the host tile output reaches the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostConf: Spend {0} hemogel from the Moon internal reserve and grow a permanent abstract outpost here? The hive leaves only {1}% of this tile output for the network and cannot be visited or removed.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostWith: There is no flesh on this tile yet. Cover it with flesh for {0} hemogel and immediately grow an outpost for another {1} hemogel? Total Moon reserve cost: {2}. The permanent abstract hive cannot be visited or removed and leaves only {3}% of its tile output for the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonOutpostCreated: The Moon has grown a flesh outpost on world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonOutpostCreatedWit: The Moon covered world tile {0} with flesh and grew a new outpost on it.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonAnchorRequired: First attach the Moon's mapless umbilicus to the current world tile.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonLowersUmbilicus: No umbilicus is attached to this tile yet, so the Moon lowers its mapless feeding link here as part of the same operation.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostRenamed: The outpost network is now called "{0}".
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostTileHiveShare: The outpost has no hemogel upkeep. Its hive retains half of the host tile production; {0}% of that tile normal output reaches this network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostsCategoryDesc: Grow additional abstract command centers on covered, unloaded and unoccupied tiles in the selected outpost network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkProductionFacilitiesD: Build abstract planetary extraction organs on covered tiles of the selected outpost network. These objects cannot be visited and multiply hemogel extraction from their host tile.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAmbushesDesc: Build abstract ambush camps on covered tiles of the selected outpost network. Camps cannot be visited, multiply host-tile extraction, and can store occasional world loot.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFacilitySourceRequire: Select a flesh outpost through the reserve bar before building planetary organs or ambush camps.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkBuildFacilityDesc: Build this abstract world object on a covered, unloaded and unoccupied tile in the selected outpost network. Cost: {1} hemogel from that network. Host tile extraction multiplier: x{2}. Facility tiles cannot be loaded as maps.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkBuildFacilityConfirm: Build {0} on world tile {1} for {2} hemogel? The tile will remain abstract and cannot be visited. Host tile extraction multiplier: x{3}.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFacilityRequiresWater: This facility requires a covered land tile with a river, coast, lake or adjacent water.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampNoRoutes: The camp is fully isolated from useful prey routes.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampMoonNotAnchored: Anchor the Moon's mapless umbilicus to this camp tile before sending stored loot upward.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampMoonMapUnavailable: The Moon interior map is not available.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampDevGenerateLootDesc: Immediately roll one ambush haul for this camp, ignoring the usual timer and chance.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampLootGenerated: The camp ambushed a caravan and stored {0} stack(s) of loot.
LanguageData.FB_DevInstantCaptureDone: Dev: world tile {0} was captured instantly.
LanguageData.FB_DevFillNetworkHemogelDesc: Fill this network's hemogel reserve up to its capacity.
LanguageData.FB_DevDrainNetworkHemogelDesc: Drain every spendable unit of hemogel from this network's reserve.
LanguageData.FB_DevNetworkHemogelFilled: Dev: {0} hemogel was added to the network.
LanguageData.FB_DevNetworkHemogelDrained: Dev: {0} hemogel was drained from the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAttackSettlementDesc: Form an abstract flesh assault party from this outpost's connected hemogel reserve, send it across the world map, and resolve the attack mathematically when it reaches a hostile humanlike settlement.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultRequiresHostil: Choose an unloaded humanlike settlement without active quest links.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultSettlementQues: This settlement is tied to an active quest and cannot be assaulted.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultSettlementLoad: This settlement's map is loaded. Assaults only work on unloaded settlements.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultLaunched: A flesh assault party was launched against {0}. Strength: {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultInspectCarrying: Hauling loot to tile {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultVictoryText: The flesh assault party destroyed {0} without opening a tactical map. Beasts returning home: {1}, lost in the fight: {2}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultDefeatedText: The flesh assault party failed to break {0}. Strength {1} was below the calculated difficulty {2}, and the committed hemogel was lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultInvalidTargetText: The target at world tile {0} is no longer a valid hostile settlement. The assault party is returning.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanCommandDesc: Grow a pack of fingerspikes, trispikes and bulbfreaks large enough to carry everything stored in this camp, then send it to a flesh outpost you pick on the world map. Right-click the corner to toggle automatic dispatch: while it is on, the camp ships its loot to the nearest outpost connected by veins every {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanNoCargo: This camp has no stored loot to carry.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanNoOutpost: No flesh outpost is connected to this camp, so the loot stays in its storage.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanRequiresOutpost: Choose one of your flesh outposts as the delivery target.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanLaunched: A supply caravan of {0} beast(s) left the camp with {1} stack(s) of loot for {2}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanArrived: A supply caravan delivered {0} stack(s) of loot to {2}. Its {1} carrier(s) dissolved into the outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanReturned: The supply caravan came back and unloaded {0} stack(s) into the camp storage.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanRerouted: The supply caravan lost its destination and is hauling the loot back to the camp on tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanLost: A supply caravan had nowhere to unload and {0} stack(s) of loot were lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanInspect: Hauling loot to tile {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanInspectReturning: Returning to the camp on tile {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorerDepleted: {0} on tile {1} has drained its tile dry and stopped producing ore. Absorb it and grow a new one on a living tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowDesc: Pick a world tile and grow the far maw of this tunnel into it. Cost: {0} hemogel per tile of distance, paid from this network. While the tunnel stands, caravans can cross it and flesh war parties reroute through it whenever that is faster.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowConfirm: Grow a tunnel maw on world tile {0}? Distance {1} tiles, cost {2} hemogel, growth takes {3}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowStarted: The nexus started boring towards world tile {0}. It will break through in {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrown: A flesh tunnel maw broke through on world tile {0}. Crossing takes {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowFailed: The tunnel could not break through: the target tile is no longer free.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldTargetInvalid: Pick a valid tile on the same planet layer.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldTargetImpassable: The tunnel cannot surface on an impassable tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCollapseDesc: Collapse this world tunnel. The far maw dies, the nexus survives and can bore a new tunnel elsewhere. Spent hemogel is not refunded.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCollapseConfirm: Collapse the tunnel? The far maw is lost and the hemogel spent on it is not refunded.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldNoLink: There is no finished flesh tunnel on this tile.

LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldDevFinishDesc: Immediately finish boring and break the far maw through, ignoring the remaining growth time.

LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCaravanStarted: {0} entered the flesh tunnel. It will surface in {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCaravanArrived: {0} surfaced from the flesh tunnel on world tile {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCaravanCancelled: {0} backed out of the flesh tunnel.
